title: E2E case result
description: The one file any browser/UI engine — scripted (Playwright) or agent-driven (Claude in Chrome) — writes per case it attempts, at <evidence.root>/<workflow>/<scope>/results/<CASE-ID>.json, per core/e2e-engine-contract.md §4. A scripted engine that only self-reports a suite-level exit code is not required to write these; an agent-driven engine has no exit code to fall back on and MUST write one of these for every case it attempts, including one it aborts partway through — a case that writes nothing here is indistinguishable from a case that never ran, and tools/aggregate-e2e-results.py treats 'nothing written' as BLOCKED, never as a silent pass.

id.description: Case ID, per core/e2e-engine-contract.md §2's <REGISTRY>-<AREA>-<NN> convention. Must match the file's own <CASE-ID>.json name.

engine.description: Which engine produced this case's verdict, e.g. 'playwright', 'claude-in-chrome', or a project-defined engine name. Free text, never special-cased by core/ tooling beyond grouping and display.

evidence.description: Repo-relative paths to this case's screenshots/recordings, under the same evidence layout. Must never contain a credential value, token, or other secret — screenshots must not show a field with a credential visibly entered.

note.description: Why this verdict — required in practice for anything other than PASS, though not schema-enforced here (schema enforcement of that lives in the same place result.schema.json enforces the analogous rule for qaVerification).
